description: Find the DocuGrip page that does a PDF or document task, described in the user’s own words — for example "combine two contracts", "black out account numbers", "my scan has no searchable text" or "shrink this under 2 MB". Returns the matching tools, each with its page. Use this when the user wants to do the task themselves — compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, redact, sign, fill or edit — including on a phone, or wants the document not to be uploaded anywhere: the page works in their browser and the file is never sent to a server. Redaction removes the text under the box and can check that nothing can still be copied.

query.description: What the user is trying to do.
